Kasimpasa vs Genclerbirligi: Live Stream & Watch Online

Watch this Turkish Super Lig clash as Istanbul’s Kasimpasa host Ankara’s Genclerbirligi at Recep Tayyip Erdoğan Stadium. Both sides are level on 14 points near the bottom of the table and desperate to pull away from the relegation zone.

Kick-off: December 12, 2025, 19:00 MSK (17:00 UTC)
Stadium: Recep Tayyip Erdoğan Stadium, Istanbul, Türkiye
Competition: Turkish Super Lig, regular season

Match Preview

Kasimpasa are 15th (3–5–7, 14:21 goal difference), while Genclerbirligi sit 14th (4–2–9, 17:21). Hosts remain winless at home this season (0–3–4, 6:12), whereas the visitors recorded 3 wins in 7 away games (10:9).

Form and Key Players

Kasimpasa

Emre Belozoglu’s team lost 3 of their last 5 league matches, scoring 4 and conceding 9. Key players: Habib Gueye (5 league goals), Claudio Winck (1 goal, 3 assists), Haris Hajradinovic (2 goals).

Genclerbirligi

The Ankara side look slightly more stable with 2 wins, 1 draw and 2 losses in their last 5 outings (7:6 aggregate). Standouts: Murat Mimaroglu and M’Baye Niang (3 goals each), plus creative support from Gurkan Gurpuz and Ogulcan Yulgun.

Head-to-Head

Genclerbirligi have a slight historical edge with 6 wins to Kasimpasa’s 5, alongside 2 draws in official meetings. These fixtures tend to be open, averaging 2.7 goals per match with frequent BTTS outcomes.

Predicted Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Kasimpasa (4-2-3-1): Gianniotis – Winck, Opoku, Frimpong, Erturk – Baldursson, Traoré – Bukhari, Hajradinovic, Ben Ouanes – Gueye.
  • Genclerbirligi (4-2-3-1): Ozorin – Kaya, Aydin, Kemal, Özgür – Yulgun, Gurpuz – Mimaroglu, Demir, Cetinkaya – Niang.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Bookmakers give a slight edge to Kasimpasa, pricing the hosts at 2.10–2.20, the draw at 3.30–3.40, and Genclerbirligi at 3.30–3.50.

  • Main Prediction: Both Teams to Score (BTTS) at around 1.75 odds. Both defenses are fragile while the attacks regularly create chances.
  • Alternative Prediction: Genclerbirligi +0.5 Handicap. Visitors are stronger away than Kasimpasa are at home, with hosts still winless on their own turf this season.

Union Berlin vs RB Leipzig: Live Stream & Watch Online

Watch this Bundesliga showdown as Union Berlin host RB Leipzig at Stadion An der Alten Försterei. The visitors chase the top spots while the hosts push for European contention, adding extra weight to this Friday-night fixture.

Kick-off: December 12, 2025, 21:30 MSK (19:30 UTC)
Stadium: Stadion An der Alten Försterei, Berlin, Germany
Competition: German Bundesliga, regular season

Match Preview

Union have had a patchy campaign, oscillating between wins and losses to sit mid-table after 13 rounds. Leipzig are in the leading pack with a solid unbeaten run and one of the league’s most potent attacks.

Team Form and Analysis

Union Berlin

The Berliners are traditionally strong at home, collecting most of their points at the Alten Försterei and averaging around 1.5 goals scored per home match. Key men: Benedict Hollerbach and Kevin Volland, who contribute the bulk of Union’s goals.

RB Leipzig

The Red Bulls rank among the top three sides for xG, shots and goals scored, averaging over 2 goals per game. Strengths lie in pacey wide play and aggressive pressing, with Lois Openda, Xavi Simons and Benjamin Šeško the main threats.

Head-to-Head

Across their last 17 meetings, Union have 6 wins, Leipzig 8, with 3 draws. These matches are often tight and physical, with many decided by set pieces despite relatively modest scorelines.

Predicted Lineups

Confirmed lineups will be available one hour before kick-off.

  • Union Berlin (3-5-2): Rønnow – Doekhi, Lenz, Leite – Trimmel, Kral, Krauß, Königsdörffer, Schäfer – Volland, Hollerbach.
  • RB Leipzig (4-2-2-2): Blaswich – Henrichs, Orban, Lukeba, Raum – Schlager, Haidara – Simons, Olmo – Openda, Šeško.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Bookmakers make RB Leipzig clear favourites at 1.80–1.90 for the away win, with the draw at 3.60–3.80 and Union priced 4.20–4.50.

  • Main Prediction: RB Leipzig to Win (2) or Double Chance X2 with Over 1.5 Goals. Leipzig’s attack is in strong form and regularly scores at least twice.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Leipzig generate plenty of chances, while Union seldom fail to score at home.

Lecce vs Pisa: Live Stream & Watch Online

Watch this crucial Serie A relegation battle as Lecce host Pisa at Stadio Via del Mare. Lecce sit 17th on 13 points (3–4–7, 10:19), while Pisa are 18th with 10 points (1–7–6, 10:19).

Kick-off: December 12, 2025, 21:45 MSK (19:45 UTC)
Stadium: Stadio Ettore Giardiniero – Via del Mare, Lecce, Italy
Competition: Serie A, Matchday 15

Match Preview

Lecce lost 2–0 to Cremonese last time out but have two wins from their last five, including against Torino (2–1) and Fiorentina (1–0). Pisa are winless in five (0–2–3) yet picked up draws versus strong sides Sassuolo (2–2) and Torino (2–2).

Team Form and Analysis

Lecce

At home Lecce average 0.7 scored and 1.1 conceded, with 4 of 7 home games finishing under 2.5 goals. Star man Medon Berisha (2 goals, 3 assists) leads the side in goal contributions, supported by Banda and Pierotti out wide.

Pisa

Away from home Pisa average 1.5 scored and 2.3 conceded, with each of their last five away fixtures going over 3.5 goals. Defensive fragility contrasts with a capable attack that often creates second-phase chances.

Head-to-Head

Historically Lecce lead with 5 wins, Pisa have 3, and 2 draws. Their most recent six meetings saw three wins each with 13 total goals (around 2.2 per match).

Predicted Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Lecce (4-2-3-1): Falcone – Gallo, Baschirotto, Tuia, Gendrey – Ramadani, Oujoun – Banda, Berisha, Pierotti – Stulic.
  • Pisa (3-5-2): Nicolas – Erlicson, Barba, Canestrelli – Beruatto, Marin, Mory, Tramoni, Barone – Torregrossa, Moreo.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Bookmakers slightly favour Lecce at 2.30–2.40 for the home win, with the draw at 3.00–3.10 and Pisa at 3.10–3.30.

  • Main Prediction: Lecce to Win (1) or Double Chance 1X. The hosts show marginally better form and have the H2H edge. Likely scoreline: 2–1.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Pisa’s open away approach and both sides’ weak defenses point towards at least three goals.

Real Sociedad vs Girona: Live Stream & Watch Online

Watch this La Liga clash as Real Sociedad host Girona at Reale Arena in San Sebastián. Both sides sit in the upper half of the table and fight for European spots, giving this match extra importance.

Kick-off: December 12, 2025, 22:00 MSK (20:00 UTC)
Stadium: Reale Arena, San Sebastián, Spain
Competition: La Liga, Matchday 16

Match Preview

Real Sociedad are inconsistent but exciting at home, with their matches averaging 3.5 goals, 1.75 scored and 1.75 conceded, and no clean sheets at Anoeta this season. Girona remain one of the league’s most attack‑minded sides yet struggle defensively, especially away.

Team Form and Analysis

Real Sociedad

La Real rarely fail to score at home and often net at least twice. Even without injured Oyarzabal, Zubeldia, Herrera and Óskarsson, the trio of Kubo, Brais Méndez and Gonçalo Guedes carries plenty of threat.

Girona

The Catalans rank near the top for goals scored and xG but also allow many chances. Wide and half‑space threats come from Tsygankov, Ounahi and Roca, with Vanat leading the line.

Head-to-Head

Girona hold the historical edge with 7 wins to Real Sociedad’s 2, alongside 6 draws in official meetings. Goal counts are fairly balanced, with roughly half of the encounters going over 2.25 goals.

Predicted Lineups

Official lineups will be confirmed one hour before kick-off.

  • Real Sociedad (4-2-3-1): Remiro – Aramburu, Aritz Elustondo, Jon Martín, Sergio Gómez – Carlos Soler, Jon Gorrotxategi – Kubo, Brais Méndez, Barrenetxea – Gonçalo Guedes.
  • Girona (4-2-3-1): Gazzaniga – Arnau Martínez, Reis, Blind, Frances – Iván Martín, Witsel – Tsygankov, Ounahi, Roca – Vanat.

Match Prediction by tutsport.net

Odds slightly favour the hosts, with Real Sociedad at 2.20–2.30, the draw 3.30–3.50 and Girona 3.10–3.30.

  • Main Prediction: Real Sociedad to Win (1) with BTTS. The hosts’ strong home scoring and Girona’s attacking firepower make a 2–1 home win a realistic scenario.
  • Total Goals Prediction: Over 2.5 Goals. Both Sociedad’s home games and Girona’s away matches tend to comfortably clear the 3‑goal line.
